corrected_by: Fable 5 reconstruction, verified in plain code by Opus 5
basis: Two defects, each evidenced by the DEED rather than by closing the traverse. (1) The R=1985 curve lost its chord line in retyping: it recites 'to a point on a curve' -- the non-tangent form this deed distinguishes from its own 'point of curvature'/'point of tangency' recitals -- and its 'length of 23.14 feet' is R*tan(delta/2)=23.141, a mislabeled TANGENT, exactly where the three intact street-crossing recitals on the same west line read 'a tangent of 15.00 feet'. Those three give the chord direction: S 89-04-46 E, S 89-09-11 E, S 89-17-19 E, each 30.00 ft, east and nearly perpendicular to the southbound travel. (2) Course 3's 534.00 ft is a transposition of 543.00.
repairs: R=1985 curve: chord reconstructed as S 89-25-00 E, 46.28 ft (2R*sin(delta/2)), and 'length of 23.14' relabelled as the tangent it arithmetically is

evidence.why_not_verified: 1:3,202 is below this project's 1:10,000 anchorable bar, so a further small misread remains; both constraints agree that the two repairs are right, not that the reading is now complete
evidence.opus_objection_withdrawn: I argued the chord must bear ~S 00-56 W by tangency to the incoming course. That assumption was unstated and the deed contradicts it: tangency would exit S 01-36-23 W where the next call reads S 00-25-11 W.
